_comment: Cross-language golden for the exporter config identity (#2069).
data is a ConfigMap data map: kubelet writes each value as the UTF-8 bytes of a file named by its key.
expected_directory_hash: SHA-256 of the per-file SHA-256 hex digests of the kept keys, concatenated in byte-sorted key order; kept = not dot-prefixed and a .yaml/.yml extension in any case.
Computed with sha256sum over the materialised files, not with either implementation.
